visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Ten comes before nine
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The scores are sorted, but 100 comes first, before 25 and 5. The sort has no compare function, so it sorts them as text.

solution.explanation: The default sort converts every item to text and compares them letter by letter, so "100" comes before "25" and "5". A compare function a - b sorts the numbers by value.

checks.label: The scores are in number order
